summary.text: Walid Hakim, a South Carolina Green Party candidate and veteran who joined the Marines, lost the November 3, 2026 election for Governor of South Carolina to Alan Wilson.
He has been affiliated at different times with several parties.

paragraphs.text: Hakim was born in Kuwait to an American mother, and WCSC reported that he joined the military as a Marine when Iraq invaded Kuwait.
The station reported that he has spent time in most of the major affiliations, including stints as a Republican and as a Democrat and a brief period with the Libertarian Party.
The South Carolina Green Party chose him as its nominee at its convention.
Hakim says he supports the military but opposes the militarization of government agencies such as U.S. Immigration and Customs Enforcement, which he says have no place in South Carolina.
His proposals included a statewide high-speed rail system for people and cargo, a year-round approach to education and a government-backed insurance scheme.
He said none of this would require higher taxes and that every agency and program under his administration would be audited.
In 2026 he ran for governor as the South Carolina Green Party’s nominee, with running mate Arnold E. Karr.
He received 0.4% of the vote to Alan Wilson's 51.6%, according to unofficial results reported by NBC News.

sources.title: WE THE PALMETTO: A Green Governor?
